local_patch.reason: The upstream periphery constant did not match keccak256 of the locally compiled pinned core UniswapV2Pair creation bytecode, so addLiquidityETH attempted to interact with a non-contract address. This one-line patch lets the genuine Router02 address the locally deployed genuine Pair.
local_patch.scope: Only the patched local deployment is exercised. It is not evidence that unmodified periphery, official Sepolia deployment, or another compiler configuration works.
